title: Twin Sensor Midpoint Reading
brief: Two temperature sensors in a cold-storage room each upload their readings for the hour already sorted from lowest to highest. The monitoring service reports the median of all readings from both sensors combined.
Implement pooledMedianReading(nums1, nums2), where nums1 and nums2 are the sorted readings from the two sensors, and return the median of all the readings together.
